description: This file defines the AppDelegate class for a macOS Flutter application, handling application lifecycle events such as termination behavior and secure state support.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: Subclass of FlutterAppDelegate that manages application lifecycle events for a Flutter macOS app.

methods.name: applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed
methods.description: Overrides the default to return true, indicating the app should terminate when the last window is closed.

methods.name: applicationSupportsSecureRestorableState
methods.description: Overrides the default to return true, indicating the app supports secure state restoration.
